population: Strict eligible observed sales, land leasehold excluded, current master geography; Seoul and collected Gyeonggi only
rank_rule: Descending unrounded median; ties retained as intervals; common eligible regions in both periods
support: At least 40 contracts and 10 complexes per period
new_build: Contract year minus current master build year: 0 to 5; unknown/future years excluded only from age denominator
share_band: Change in new-build trade share, lower inclusive / upper exclusive, 5 percentage-point bands
fixed_definition: Same complex and exact reported area cells, at least 3 trades in each period; equal cell medians within each complex then equal complex means within region; ranks on same fixed-eligible peers
removal_definition: Remove highest contract-count complex separately each period; rank focal median against other regions original medians; null if support lost
information_cutoff: Unknown historical availability cutoff; current retained vintage, not a real-time backtest
limitations: Ranks are not investment returns or same-home price changes
Fixed comparison changes the housing set and the statistic/weights; not a causal supply effect
2015 cancellation/direct-sale non-disclosure is not confirmation of 2026 disclosure status
